# AI Narrative Model Picker Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Add a Fast/Balanced/Best model-tier dropdown to the existing "Explain My Plan" card, so the narrative can be generated by a different model without the client ever choosing (or being trusted with) a raw model ID.

**Architecture:** A static, server-only tier→model lookup table (`lib/ai/model-tiers.ts`) is the single source of truth for which model ID each tier maps to. The client sends only a tier key; the Route Handler resolves it, falling back to the default tier for anything unrecognized. The selected tier is a plain `localStorage`-backed UI preference, included in the narrative hook's request payload and cache key so switching tiers always triggers a fresh generation.

**Tech Stack:** Next.js Route Handler, Vercel AI Gateway (`ai` package, already installed), shadcn `Select`, `localStorage`.

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-01-ai-model-picker-design.md`

## Global Constraints

- The client never sends a raw model ID — only a tier key (`"fast" | "balanced" | "best"`). Only `app/api/plan-narrative/route.ts` resolves a tier to an actual model ID, via `MODEL_TIERS`.
- An unrecognized/missing tier in the request body is a **silent server-side fallback** to `DEFAULT_MODEL_TIER`'s model — never a user-facing error.
- Model IDs as of 2026-08-01: `fast` → `anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5`, `balanced` (default) → `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5`, `best` → `anthropic/claude-opus-5`. **Re-verify these are still current** at implementation time via `curl -s https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh/v1/models | jq -r '[.data[] | select(.id | startswith("anthropic/")) | .id] | reverse | .[]'` before writing `model-tiers.ts` — do not assume this table is still accurate if this plan is executed significantly later.
- The tier preference is `localStorage`-only (key: `"plan-narrative-model-tier"`) — no new Zustand store, no server-side/per-account persistence. This is a plain UI preference, unlike the narrative text/cache which needed a Zustand store to survive in-app navigation.
- Selecting a different tier must be a cache miss (never show one tier's cached text under a different tier's label) — achieved by including `tier` in the hook's cache key, not by any special-case logic.
- Plain tier labels only ("Fast", "Balanced", "Best") — no cost/speed hint text in the UI, per the approved design.
- No new test files for `lib/ai/model-tiers.ts` (a static lookup table, no logic) or the Route Handler's tier-resolution branch (verified by manual curl check) — consistent with the Route Handler already being untested per the original AI narrative plan.
- `npm run typecheck` must pass before committing.

- [ ] **Step 2: Write the tier lookup table**

Create `lib/ai/model-tiers.ts`:

```ts
export type ModelTier = "fast" | "balanced" | "best"

export const MODEL_TIERS: Record<ModelTier, string> = {
  fast: "anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5",
  balanced: "anthropic/claude-sonnet-5",
  best: "anthropic/claude-opus-5",
}

export const DEFAULT_MODEL_TIER: ModelTier = "balanced"
```

(Use the model IDs confirmed in Step 1 if they differ from the above.)

- [ ] **Step 3: Update the Route Handler to resolve tier → model**

Modify `app/api/plan-narrative/route.ts` to:

```ts
import { streamText } from "ai"
import { buildPlanNarrativePrompt, type PlanNarrativePayload } from "@/lib/ai/plan-narrative-prompt"
import { MODEL_TIERS, DEFAULT_MODEL_TIER, type ModelTier } from "@/lib/ai/model-tiers"

interface PlanNarrativeRequestBody extends PlanNarrativePayload {
  tier?: string
}

function resolveModel(tier: string | undefined): string {
  if (tier && tier in MODEL_TIERS) {
    return MODEL_TIERS[tier as ModelTier]
  }
  return MODEL_TIERS[DEFAULT_MODEL_TIER]
}

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  const body = (await request.json()) as PlanNarrativeRequestBody
  const { tier, ...payload } = body
  const { system, prompt } = buildPlanNarrativePrompt(payload)

  const result = streamText({
    model: resolveModel(tier),
    system,
    prompt,
  })

  return result.toTextStreamResponse()
}
```

### Task 2: Tier dropdown on the narrative card

**Files:**
- Modify: `lib/hooks/use-plan-narrative.ts`
- Modify: `components/dashboard/plan-narrative-card.tsx`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `ModelTier`, `DEFAULT_MODEL_TIER` from Task 1 (`lib/ai/model-tiers.ts`); `Select`/`SelectTrigger`/`SelectValue`/`SelectContent`/`SelectItem` from `components/ui/select.tsx` (existing, see usage pattern in `components/inputs/drawdown-strategy-form.tsx`).
- Produces: `usePlanNarrative`'s input gains a required `tier: ModelTier` field; its cache key now includes the tier, so tier changes are always cache misses.

- [ ] **Step 1: Add `tier` to the hook's input and request payload**

In `lib/hooks/use-plan-narrative.ts`, add the import and extend the interface:

```ts
import type { ModelTier } from "@/lib/ai/model-tiers"

interface UsePlanNarrativeInput {
  accounts: Account[]
  personalInfo: PersonalInfo
  retirementGoals: RetirementGoals
  drawdownConfig: DrawdownConfig
  projection: ProjectionResult | null
  simulationResult: SimulationResult | null
  tier: ModelTier
}
```

Then change the payload-building line inside `generate` from:

```ts
const payloadJson = JSON.stringify(payload)
```

to:

```ts
const payloadJson = JSON.stringify({ ...payload, tier: input.tier })
```

No other change to the hook — `cache`, `setCache`, and the rest of the flow are unaffected since `payloadJson` already flows through them as before, just with `tier` now baked into its content (which is exactly what makes tier changes a cache miss).

- [ ] **Step 2: Add the tier `<Select>` to the card**

Modify `components/dashboard/plan-narrative-card.tsx` to:

```tsx
"use client"

import { useEffect, useState } from "react"
import { useShallow } from "zustand/react/shallow"
import { PageCard } from "@/components/ui/page-card"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "@/components/ui/select"
import { useCalculatorStore } from "@/lib/store/calculator-store"
import { useCalculator } from "@/lib/context/calculator-context"
import { usePlanNarrative } from "@/lib/hooks/use-plan-narrative"
import { DEFAULT_MODEL_TIER, type ModelTier } from "@/lib/ai/model-tiers"
import { Sparkles } from "lucide-react"

const TIER_LABELS: Record<ModelTier, string> = {
  fast: "Fast",
  balanced: "Balanced",
  best: "Best",
}

const TIER_STORAGE_KEY = "plan-narrative-model-tier"

function isModelTier(value: string): value is ModelTier {
  return value in TIER_LABELS
}

export function PlanNarrativeCard() {
  const { accounts, personalInfo, retirementGoals, drawdownConfig } = useCalculatorStore(
    useShallow((state) => ({
      accounts: state.accounts,
      personalInfo: state.personalInfo,
      retirementGoals: state.retirementGoals,
      drawdownConfig: state.drawdownConfig,
    }))
  )
  const { projection, simulationResult } = useCalculator()

  const [tier, setTier] = useState<ModelTier>(DEFAULT_MODEL_TIER)

  useEffect(() => {
    const stored = localStorage.getItem(TIER_STORAGE_KEY)
    if (stored && isModelTier(stored)) setTier(stored)
  }, [])

  const handleTierChange = (value: string) => {
    if (!isModelTier(value)) return
    setTier(value)
    localStorage.setItem(TIER_STORAGE_KEY, value)
  }

  const { text, isStreaming, error, cooldownRemaining, generate, clear } = usePlanNarrative({
    accounts,
    personalInfo,
    retirementGoals,
    drawdownConfig,
    projection,
    simulationResult,
    tier,
  })

  if (accounts.length === 0 || !projection) return null

  const buttonLabel = isStreaming
    ? "Generating…"
    : cooldownRemaining > 0
      ? `Try again in ${cooldownRemaining}s`
      : text
        ? "Regenerate"
        : "Explain my plan"

  return (
    <PageCard
      label="Explain My Plan"
      leading={<Sparkles className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />}
      contentClassName="space-y-3"
    >
      {text && <p className="text-sm leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap">{text}</p>}

      {error && <p className="text-sm text-destructive">{error}</p>}

      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <Button
          variant={text ? "outline" : "default"}
          size="sm"
          onClick={generate}
          disabled={isStreaming || cooldownRemaining > 0}
        >
          {buttonLabel}
        </Button>

        {text && (
          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={clear} disabled={isStreaming}>
            Clear
          </Button>
        )}

        <Select value={tier} onValueChange={handleTierChange} disabled={isStreaming}>
          <SelectTrigger className="w-28 h-8 text-xs">
            <SelectValue />
          </SelectTrigger>
          <SelectContent>
            {(Object.keys(TIER_LABELS) as ModelTier[]).map((value) => (
              <SelectItem key={value} value={value}>
                {TIER_LABELS[value]}
              </SelectItem>
            ))}
          </SelectContent>
        </Select>
      </div>

      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
        Generating uses AI and sends your plan&apos;s numbers to our AI provider. This is an automated
        educational summary, not financial advice — consult a licensed financial advisor before making
        decisions.
      </p>
    </PageCard>
  )
}
```

Note `disabled` is on `<Select>` itself (the Radix root), not on `<SelectTrigger>` — matching how `Select`'s props forward directly to `SelectPrimitive.Root` in `components/ui/select.tsx`.
